objective: Sincronizador | LA ESTELAR | 23/04/2026 | Diagnosticar la causa real del RUNTIMEERROR_UNCLASSIFIED del extractor SoftRestaurant. Revisar exclusivamente la ventana canonica 2026-04-23 09:00 a 2026-04-24 09:00 para detectar folios duplicados/inconsistentes o encabezados en cero con detalle monetario. Solo lectura.

queries.name: estelar_20260423_source_aggregate
queries.sql:
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS cheque_rows,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CONVERT(varchar(64),ch.folio)) AS folios_distintos,
    CAST(ROUND(SUM(ISNULL(ch.total,0)),2) AS decimal(18,2)) AS venta_total,
    SUM(ISNULL(ch.nopersonas,0)) AS pax_total
FROM cheques ch WITH (NOLOCK)
INNER JOIN turnos tr WITH (NOLOCK)
    ON tr.idturno=ch.idturno
WHERE tr.apertura >= '2026-04-23 09:00:00'
  AND tr.apertura <  '2026-04-24 09:00:00'
  AND ISNULL(ch.cancelado,0)=0

queries.name: estelar_20260423_duplicate_or_inconsistent_folios
queries.sql:
SELECT
    ch.folio,
    COUNT(*) AS cheque_rows,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ch.idturno) AS turnos,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(ISNULL(ch.total,0) AS decimal(18,2))) AS totales_distintos,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ISNULL(ch.nopersonas,0)) AS pax_distintos,
    MIN(CAST(ISNULL(ch.total,0) AS decimal(18,2))) AS total_min,
    MAX(CAST(ISNULL(ch.total,0) AS decimal(18,2))) AS total_max,
    MIN(ISNULL(ch.nopersonas,0)) AS pax_min,
    MAX(ISNULL(ch.nopersonas,0)) AS pax_max,
    MIN(ch.fecha) AS fecha_min,
    MAX(ch.fecha) AS fecha_max,
    MIN(tr.apertura) AS apertura_min,
    MAX(tr.apertura) AS apertura_max
FROM cheques ch WITH (NOLOCK)
INNER JOIN turnos tr WITH (NOLOCK)
    ON tr.idturno=ch.idturno
WHERE tr.apertura >= '2026-04-23 09:00:00'
  AND tr.apertura <  '2026-04-24 09:00:00'
  AND ISNULL(ch.cancelado,0)=0
GROUP BY ch.folio
HAVING COUNT(*)>1
    OR COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(ISNULL(ch.total,0) AS decimal(18,2)))>1
    OR COUNT(DISTINCT ISNULL(ch.nopersonas,0))>1
ORDER BY ch.folio

queries.name: estelar_20260423_zero_header_with_detail
queries.sql:
WITH h AS (
    SELECT ch.folio, ch.idturno, ch.fecha,
           CAST(ISNULL(ch.total,0) AS decimal(18,4)) AS total_header,
           ISNULL(ch.nopersonas,0) AS pax
    FROM cheques ch WITH (NOLOCK)
    INNER JOIN turnos tr WITH (NOLOCK)
      ON tr.idturno=ch.idturno
    WHERE tr.apertura >= '2026-04-23 09:00:00'
      AND tr.apertura <  '2026-04-24 09:00:00'
      AND ISNULL(ch.cancelado,0)=0
),
d AS (
    SELECT foliodet,
           CAST(SUM(CAST(ISNULL(cantidad,0)*ISNULL(precio,0) AS decimal(18,4))) AS decimal(18,4)) AS bruto_detalle,
           COUNT(*) AS lineas
    FROM cheqdet WITH (NOLOCK)
    GROUP BY foliodet
)
SELECT h.folio,h.idturno,h.fecha,h.total_header,h.pax,
       ISNULL(d.bruto_detalle,0) AS bruto_detalle,
       CAST(ISNULL(d.bruto_detalle,0)-h.total_header AS decimal(18,4)) AS delta,
       ISNULL(d.lineas,0) AS lineas
FROM h
LEFT JOIN d ON d.foliodet=h.folio
WHERE h.total_header=0
  AND ABS(ISNULL(d.bruto_detalle,0))>0.05
ORDER BY h.folio
